ai.instructions: Is this Korean listing a competition whose topic or required work involves artificial intelligence (AI, machine learning, LLMs, generative AI, data science)?

criteria.true: Participants use, build, or propose AI, or the contest theme is AI
criteria.false: AI is not part of the contest, or it is only mentioned in passing

contest.instructions: Does this Korean listing recruit participants or teams for a competition, contest, hackathon, or challenge that is still open for entry?

criteria.true: An open call for entries to a competition
criteria.false: A lecture, education program, job posting, event, or a results/award announcement

category.instructions: Which kind of competition is this Korean listing?

criteria.hackathon: A hackathon, ideathon, or other time-boxed team build event
criteria.startup: A startup, business plan, commercialization, or investment/IR pitch competition
criteria.tourism: A tourism, travel, or MICE themed competition
criteria.academic: An academic paper, research, or scholarly competition
criteria.data: A data analysis, data science, or machine learning modeling competition
criteria.creative: A creative contest: video, image, music, design, writing, webtoon, character, advertising
criteria.youth: A competition only for children, teenagers, or school students
criteria.dev: A software development, coding, app/web, robotics, or security competition
criteria.idea: An idea, policy proposal, or planning competition
